name: XDKNet 3.0.0.1
body:
XDKNet 3.0.0.1. The Android TV app and the server plugin now share one
version and come out together on one release, so the app on your TV and the
plugin on your server always match by number.

## Watch Parties

- A Watch Party movie no longer stays paused in the web app. When the room
  held everyone for a moment while the server prepared the stream, the
  browser showed "The play() request was interrupted by a call to pause()"
  and the movie never started, even with Play.
- On every device, if the room is playing while your own video is paused,
  Play now starts yours and lines it up with the room, instead of pulling
  everyone back to where you are.

Nothing else in the app changes from Android TV 2.9.0, and the plugin is the
same as 2.1.0.19 apart from the web app inside it.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.
